newsitem.title: UK: WH Smith launches loyalty card-paper.
newsitem.headline: WH Smith launches loyalty card-paper.

text.p: WH Smith Plc is launching a loyalty card scheme this week to help ward off rumoured takeover offers, the Guardian newspaper said on Monday.
The retail group, hit by the abrupt departure in June of group chief executive Bill Cockburn, is also scrutinising its share register to ensure no hostile stakes are being built up, the paper said.

No such hostile stakes have been spotted but the newspaper quoted insiders as saying no one in the group was ruling out a possible bid. The group's shares closed at 343 pence on Friday compared with a year high of 486.
